# veraPDF test corpus

- **Title:** veraPDF test corpus
- **Author:** veraPDF Consortium
- **Source:** https://github.com/veraPDF/veraPDF-corpus
- **Commit:** `bb75f4f0073d9350dfd058c0162a367e6fadf25e`
- **License:** Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0),
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ — full legal code in [`LICENSE`](LICENSE).

Files are unmodified; selected subset. Each file sits at the same relative path it has in the
upstream repository. [`manifest.toml`](manifest.toml) lists every vendored file with its SHA-256,
the standard and clause it exercises, and whether it is expected to pass or fail.

Not vendored on purpose: the upstream `Isartor test files` directory (its terms forbid
redistribution) and the `TWG test files` directory (no explicit CC BY 4.0 grant).
